finding.expected: Close the direct-construction bypass without weakening the canonical factory or changing P7.7 authority. Keep WinnerValidationAssessment publicly exportable as the immutable result type, but make valid instances constructible only through the canonical create_winner_validation_assessment path, or otherwise ensure direct construction cannot fabricate P7.3/P7.6 binding or unanchored assessment evidence. Add focused regression proving direct public construction fails closed while canonical factory construction still succeeds and preserves all existing identity, time, anchoring, dimension, and coherence rules. Preserve all other P7.7 semantics and roadmap state.
finding.issue: The exported WinnerValidationAssessment is directly constructible and its public constructor accepts caller-supplied decision_context_id, hypothesis_id, market_test_profile_ids, supporting_evidence_refs, and counter_evidence_refs without access to or verification against the exact bound DecisionContext, OpportunityHypothesis, and MarketTestEvidenceProfile objects. The canonical factory correctly verifies exact P7.3/P7.6 identity, time, evidence anchoring, and collective represented-dimension constraints, but direct construction bypasses those checks. A caller can therefore create a public P7.7 semantic value that claims arbitrary P7.3/P7.6 lineage or invented evidence references. This also defeats AC3's requirement that assessment evidence be anchored to exact bound P7.6 profiles.
